# 01 â€” CORE PREMISE

## The setting

> CANON: The year is 2024. Technology, cities, finance, governments, militaries, social media, universities, hospitals, religions, and criminal organizations are those of the real modern world, with one difference: supernatural phenomena exist.

Some people â€” roughly 1 in 5,000 â€” carry a neural trait that lets them deliberately channel pressure from beneath reality. They are called **the Attuned**. Objects, places, organisms, events, and even pieces of information sometimes exhibit impossible properties. These are called **Seeps** (in official Meridian terminology: **anomalies**).

Some Seeps are trivial. Some are inconvenient. Some are weapons-grade. A few are civilization-threatening.

Governments know. Major corporations know. Intelligence agencies know. Some militaries, some religions, some crime syndicates, and some old-money families know. The general public knows only fragments: urban legends, a strange night nobody can quite remember, conspiracy subcultures, a meme about "the Quiet."

## The central engine of the story

> CANON: The world is entering a **High Tide** â€” a centuries-cycle peak in the pressure leaking up from beneath reality. Seep frequency has roughly tripled since 2000. The systems that kept the supernatural hidden for eighty years are straining under smartphones, livestreaming, and synthetic media â€” and under the rising pressure itself.

The novel's long-run tension is therefore structural, not villain-driven: **the masquerade is becoming more expensive to maintain at exactly the moment the phenomena are becoming harder to hide.** Every faction â€” governments, corporations, cults, criminals â€” is quietly preparing for a world where secrecy fails.

## Why civilization hasn't collapsed

> CANON: Civilization endures because of seven interlocking facts, not one miracle:

1. **Rarity.** ~96â€“98% of humanity has a strong **Veil Reflex** (called "the Quiet" in civilian slang): a subconscious cognitive immune response that rationalizes, degrades, or deletes memories of Seep exposure within hours. Most people literally cannot retain what they saw.
2. **Rot.** Recordings of active Seeps degrade â€” "static rot." Undertow-structured information does not persist cleanly in Membrane media. The stronger the Seep, the faster the footage corrupts.
3. **Noise.** Since the 1990s, intelligence-adjacent media operations have flooded the internet with fake paranormal content. Real leaks drown in ten thousand fakes. Since ~2020, the **deepfake dividend** has done the rest: nobody trusts video anymore, which is the best secrecy ally ever invented.
4. **Weakness of the median Seep.** The overwhelming majority of Seeps are T0â€“T2: harmless, useless, or merely strange. Civilization-threatening Seeps are rare and draw immediate multi-faction response.
5. **Eighty years of infrastructure.** Since the 1949 Meridian Accords, a global apparatus exists: the Seismograph detection network, Sweeper teams, Quiet Insurance, containment engineering, the Meridian Compact's arbitration courts. This machine has had three generations to professionalize.
6. **Erosion.** Channeling power destroys the channeler. The strongest Attuned burn out fastest â€” a built-in ceiling on any individual's ability to dominate. There is no immortal god-king because the price of godhood is self-dissolution ("Drowning").
7. **No adversary.** The Undertow does not want anything. There is no intelligent enemy trying to end the world â€” only pressure, and humans exploiting it. (Whether this is *true* is a Layer-5 mystery; see `33_MYSTERIES.md`. What every expert *believes* is that there is no adversary.)

> STATUS: THEORY (in-world expert consensus): "The masquerade can hold indefinitely with sufficient funding." A growing minority of analysts inside the Compact privately believe it cannot survive the High Tide.

## Tone and atmosphere

- **Oppressive hidden organizations** (Black Haze register): the world is administered by tired, competent, morally gray bureaucracies that file paperwork about impossible things.
- **Abilities with costs** (Darker than Black register): every power is a contract with an installment plan, and the installments are paid in selfhood. Operators are professionals, not heroes.
- **Horror inside working life** (workplace-horror register): the supernatural exists next to shift schedules, rent, insurance claims, and office politics. A containment operation can close your street while you are buying coffee two blocks away.

## Protagonist foundation

> CANON: **CHAR-001 â€” Arthur Reed** (Arthur Reed), 24, male, a native of **Ravenhurst City, Albion** (the primary narrative metro; see regional directive below) â€” an ordinary modern British man, economically modest, socially unremarkable, with no famous family, no bloodline, and no connections that matter. Night-shift records clerk â€” a regular employee â€” at the **Ravenhurst branch of Nusantara Quiet Assurance** (HQ Jakarta), a mid-size insurer selling "Quiet policies" (post-exposure memory cover and incident care). He is **Loud** (he remembers Seep events perfectly) but **not Attuned** â€” he has no supernatural ability of his own.

Arthur is genuinely weak: no combat training, no power, no money, no connections. No visa precarity â€” he is a citizen â€” but a thinner kind: his name sits in a flagged NQA hiring file, in the SMD's thin Ravenhurst file from the old-quarter replay, and in the Quiet Desk's human-intelligence interest. He cannot afford any more files. What he has:

- **Total recall of the supernatural.** The Veil Reflex barely touches him. He remembers every strange thing he has ever seen, in detail. In a world where everyone's evidence rots, a perfect witness is an asset â€” and a target.
- **ANOMALY-001, "the Laggard"** â€” a second shadow that lags ~3 seconds behind him. It looks useless. It is inconvenient (it drinks light; rooms dim around him; people notice). Factions that scan him classify it T1/C-A: a curiosity. (Its true nature is documented in `29_PROTAGONIST_ANOMALY.md`.)
- **A clerk's skill set:** indexing, cross-referencing, noticing when a file doesn't match the file next to it. He survives by observation, preparation, rule-exploitation, and understanding his anomaly better than the people trying to take it from him.

> CANON: Arthur is never secretly omnipotent. His progression is earned: each new use of the Laggard is discovered through observation and paid for in risk, never granted by revelation.

## Regional directive (CANON)

The primary country is **JAPAN** (COUNTRY-001) â€” **selected by user order (2026-09-19).** This relocation explicitly overrides the v0.4 evaluation's "not picked by fame" exclusion: Albion was chosen because the user directed it. The relocation writer records for the audit trail that the choice is structurally sound regardless â€” Albion scores highest on the 12 structural criteria the v0.4 evaluation used: urban density, infrastructure, economy, corporate environment, government structure, historical depth, folklore, religious diversity, international connections, containment suitability, underground-org suitability, and serialized-storytelling suitability. Full evaluation reasoning for the previous selection is preserved in `20_GEOGRAPHY.md`.

- The primary threshold agency is **GOV-006, the Special Measures Division (SMD)** â€” Arthur's jurisdiction for containment, Sweeper response, and the thin Ravenhurst file on his name.

Liwanag remains load-bearing in the backstory: the old-quarter replay ([EVENT-092](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)), Aisha Rahman's KNF tenure, and the Alon Combine's origin chapter.

Indonesia holds particular strategic importance (maritime chokepoints, archipelagic scale, population, BPF, NQA HQ) without being unrealistically powerful.

- Story-scale lens enforced throughout: **HOME â†’ CITY â†’ COUNTRY â†’ REGION â†’ WORLD**.
- Regional consistency rule: one global supernatural system; regions differ only in interpretation, regulation, containment, and exploitation â€” never separate magic systems.

## What this bible must support

Hundreds of chapters across mystery, thriller, action, psychological warfare, horror, romance, slice-of-life, investigation, politics, economics, workplace drama, and faction warfare â€” without the worldbuilding collapsing under power escalation, economic impossibility, or political inconsistency. The world must feel older than Arthur and indifferent to him: it existed long before he was born and will continue after he dies.

# 02 â€” WORLD RULES

These are the load-bearing rules. Everything in this bible â€” every faction plan, every ability, every economy â€” must obey them. Rules marked CANON-LOCKED cannot be changed without a CHANGELOG entry explaining the contradiction that forced the change.

## I. Metaphysical hard rules (CANON-LOCKED)

> CANON-LOCKED: **No true resurrection.** Death collapses a person's pattern. Anything that "returns" from the Undertow wearing a dead person's shape is an **echo**: it has memories up to the point of pattern-capture, but it is not the person. Echoes degrade. Every faction's science and every religion's theology has independently confirmed this at least once, usually at terrible cost.

> CANON-LOCKED: **No permanent created matter.** Matter "borrowed" from the Undertow **reverts** within 72 hours (usually much sooner for complex structures). You can build a bridge of borrowed steel to escape a burning building; you cannot build a borrowed-steel empire.

> CANON-LOCKED: **The past cannot be changed.** The Undertow has no time. Its "memories" of the past â€” **Tide-marks** â€” are impressions only: viewable, never editable. Any ability, ritual, or anomaly claiming to alter the past is either viewing Tide-marks, creating a local causal bubble (see below), or lying.

> CANON-LOCKED: **No direct mind control.** A mind is a Membrane phenomenon; the Undertow cannot grip it directly. What *is* possible is **suggestion seeding** through the informational layer: planting impulses the target experiences as their own thoughts. It is resisted by awareness, strong identity, training, and (ironically) stubbornness; it always produces **backlash** â€” the seeder experiences a distorted echo of the implanted impulse. **Mass reliable mind control is logistically impossible; per-link unreliability compounds geometrically, and each link pays backlash.**

> CANON-LOCKED: **No power copying.** A Resonance is a unique neural pattern. "Copying" an ability requires consuming the source's pattern â€” i.e., killing them in a specific, difficult, Drowning-adjacent manner â€” and even then the thief's Erosion accelerates catastrophically. There are no power-sponges walking around with forty abilities. (There are three corpses in Compact vaults that prove why.)

> CANON-LOCKED: **Patterns can only be captured during collapse.** The theft above is possible only in the moment of pattern collapse (the Drowning-adjacent window); a stable, living pattern cannot be taken, sampled, or siphoned. The procedure requires a **T3+ Lantern examiner**, is **Seismograph-visible** (it reads as a T4+ event), and is lawful only with the **subject's consent or a Tribunal warrant** â€” without one it is murder and pattern-theft, the two charges the Tribunal has never once declined to prosecute.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Slipping (teleportation) has anchors.** Crossing the Undertow to relocate is possible, but arrival requires **recognition**: you can only arrive somewhere you have been, or somewhere held strongly and accurately in the living memory of **someone who knows you** â€” *someone* meaning **another living person**, not yourself, not an echo, not a recording. You cannot slip into a vault you have never seen, a country you cannot picture, or "behind" a person. Each slip costs Erosion proportional to distance and unfamiliarity. Warded/contained zones shred unrecognized arrivals. **Hardened wards shred all non-whitelisted arrivals** â€” recognized or not, the ward checks the whitelist, not the memory. And **recognition decays**: arrival-grade memory fades with time and inaccuracy â€” a place you visited twenty years ago and barely remember is not an anchor. **Slip-courier chains** (relaying cargo Slip-to-Slip) are legal but **economically dead**: each link pays the full Erosion cost of its leg, and the chain's price compounds past any cargo's value within three hops â€” except for emergencies, where the price is the point.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Erosion is irreversible.** Channeling wears the Veil. Stillness practices, drugs, and rest can *slow* further Erosion; nothing reverses it. At 100 Fathoms the user **Drowns** â€” pattern dissolution, usually leaving a new Seep behind.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Causal bubbles are small, brief, and expensive.** Local time dilation/acceleration (a room where seconds stretch) by **Attuned channeling** is possible. It cannot extend beyond line-of-sight scale, cannot last more than minutes, and costs Erosion at a ruinous rate. There are no time-loop fortresses.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Anomaly Rules may exceed the Attuned channeling caps â€” and inherit proportional costs.** A Seep's Rule can sustain a larger or longer causal bubble than any Attuned could, but the excess is priced into the anomaly itself: larger Tide pressure, wider Seismograph visibility, faster Undertow attention, harder containment. Nothing gets the effect for free; the bill is just denominated differently.

## II. Economic hard rules (CANON-LOCKED)

> CANON-LOCKED: **Anomalies are non-fungible.** Every Seep is unique. There is no commodity market in "anomaly units" â€” only auctions of specific items with specific Rules. This single fact prevents most infinite-wealth schemes: you cannot scale what you cannot reproduce.

> CANON-LOCKED: **The Seismograph network sees large Tide events.** Any channeling above ~T3, any unregistered Slipping, any active T4+ Seep triggers detectors on every continent within minutes. Unregistered large-scale use is therefore *visible* â€” the question is only who responds first.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Borrowed wealth reverts.** Because created matter reverts (Rule I), no fortune can be built on conjured gold, conjured oil, or conjured anything. Financial-precognition abilities exist at small scales and are the reason every major exchange runs Lantern-screened compliance â€” and the reason "lucky" traders keep Drowning.

> CANON: **Licensed conjuration contracting is a real trade.** Temporary tooling â€” formwork, molds, scaffolding, shoring â€” conjured to shape *real* matter is legal under license in 60+ signatories: it is Seismograph-visible at scale, Erosion-priced by the job, and regulated like explosives handling. It survives because the economics *usually* favor mundane alternatives â€” conjured tooling is a premium product for sites where cranes can't go and time costs more than Fathoms. Unlicensed conjuration contracting is the misdemeanor the trade's inspectors actually spend their time on.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Information is the scarce resource, not power.** Raw power is common enough to be cheap; *reliable, specific, actionable knowledge* about Rules, Tide-marks, and faction intentions is what money actually buys.

## III. Secrecy hard rules (CANON-LOCKED)

> CANON-LOCKED: **The Veil Reflex is universal and involuntary.** ~96â€“98% of humans rationalize or forget Seep exposure. It cannot be "trained away" in ordinary people; removing it requires becoming Loud, which requires either birth or a Seep event â€” both rare.

> CANON-LOCKED: **Static rot is proportional to intensity.** Recordings of active Seeps corrupt at a rate proportional to the Seep's Tide pressure. A T1's party trick films fine. A T5 event leaves melted sensors and four seconds of screaming static. This is why "undeniable footage" keeps failing to materialize.

> CANON-LOCKED: **The deepfake dividend cuts both ways.** Synthetic media has destroyed public trust in video evidence. This protects the masquerade â€” but it also means *factions cannot prove things to each other either*, which is why the Compact's closed verification protocols (witnessed, multi-sensor, in-person) are the only currency of proof that matters.

## IV. Narrative rules (CANON)

> CANON: **Power is legible.** Every ability and anomaly follows a Rule that can, in principle, be discovered through observation. There are no "it just works" powers. If Arthur cannot eventually figure out *why* something happened, it should not have happened.

> CANON: **Competence is distributed.** Governments, corporations, and factions employ intelligent professionals. "Why didn't they justâ€¦?" must always have an answer: incentives, constraints, cost, law, politics, or Erosion.

> CANON: **The world is indifferent.** The Undertow is not evil. Factions are not evil-by-job-description. Catastrophes come from incentives and pressure, not malice quotas.

> CANON: **Mystery is budgeted.** Five mystery layers exist (see `33_MYSTERIES.md`). A mystery labeled INTENTIONAL MYSTERY is a promise to the reader; a mystery that is merely an unexplained gap is a bug. Never relabel a bug as a mystery.

## V. Rule-change policy

- CANON-LOCKED rules change only via CHANGELOG entry with: the contradiction found, three considered solutions, the chosen solution, and its secondary consequences.
- New CANON must not contradict CANON-LOCKED. PROVISIONAL entries are re-audited each cycle.
- In-world characters may *believe* false rules. Those beliefs are labeled `STATUS: THEORY` or `STATUS: IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION`, never stated as plain CANON.

# 03 â€” SUPERNATURAL SYSTEM

## 3.1 OBJECTIVE TRUTH (what is actually happening)

> CANON-LOCKED: The following is true whether or not any character ever learns it. In-world, **no living person knows all of it**. The closest human model (the Compact's Membrane Theory) gets roughly 70% right and is wrong about the cause of the Tide.

### The Membrane and the Undertow

> CANON: Reality as humans experience it is a thin, semi-permeable **Membrane** â€” the layer where causality, time, and identity hold â€” stretched over a deeper substrate: **the Undertow**, a lightless ocean of raw, unstructured information in which causality, time, and identity do not hold.

The Membrane is not perfectly sealed. At points of stress â€” geological, emotional, historical, informational â€” pressure from below intrudes. A **Seep** is any place, object, organism, event, or piece of information where Undertow pressure has intruded and *set* into Membrane-consistent behavior.

> CANON: Seeps are not "magic." They are intrusions of a deeper rule-set behaving as consistently as they can inside ours. Every Seep follows a **Rule** â€” alien, but fixed and discoverable. A Seep that "always counts the people in a room and removes the thirteenth" is not being cruel; it is executing Undertow grammar the way a crystal executes geometry.

### The Veil Reflex ("the Quiet")

> CANON: Human minds evolved a subconscious cognitive immune response â€” the **Veil Reflex** â€” that rationalizes, degrades, or deletes memories of Seep exposure. It is involuntary, universal in degree-varying strength, and the single largest reason civilization functions.

- ~96â€“98% of humans ("the Quiet majority") lose most Seep memories within hours, retaining only a dreamlike residue.
- ~2â€“4% are **Loud**: the Veil barely touches them. They remember **every Seep event** â€” unusually vivid, unusually stable, resistant to editing â€” but *not* everything: Loudness is resistance to Veil loss, not general eidetic memory. Mundane recall is ordinary, sometimes worse (the vivid signal drowns the quiet one). Loudness is inborn or acquired through Seep exposure; it cannot be trained into the Quiet majority.
- The Veil is *not* perfect: it edits memory, not physics. Insurance claims, broken windows, and corpses remain â€” which is why Quiet Insurance exists.

### The Hollow Pattern and the Attuned

> CANON: ~1 in 5,000 humans carries the **Hollow Pattern**, a distinctive cortical folding structure (detectable by MRI, which is why several countries quietly screen for it). In the Loud subset of carriers, the pattern allows **deliberate channeling** of Undertow pressure. These people are **the Attuned** â€” what the public would call "superpowered."

- Carrying the pattern is not enough: it must be **Awakened**, almost always by trauma, near-death, or direct Seep exposure ("First Tide").
- Inheritance raises the odds (children of Attuned awaken ~30Ã— more often) but guarantees nothing.
- Channeling is *willed intrusion*: the Attuned opens a controlled Seep through their own nervous system.

### Erosion and Drowning

> CANON: Every deliberate channeling wears the user's Veil â€” measurable as **Erosion**, colloquially counted in **Fathoms** (0â€“100). Erosion is irreversible. At 100 Fathoms the pattern dissolves: **Drowning**. The Drowned usually leave a new Seep where they stood.

This is the system's built-in ceiling: the more you use power, the less of *you* remains to use it. The strongest burn out fastest. (Full mechanics in `04_POWER_SYSTEM.md`.)

### The Tide cycle

> CANON: Undertow pressure oscillates on a centuries-long cycle. We are entering a **High Tide** â€” the first since the 14th century. Global Seep frequency has roughly tripled since 2000 and is still rising. Tide pressure is *why* the masquerade is straining: more events, stronger events, more Loud witnesses.

> STATUS: UNKNOWN (author-level intentional mystery): **what drives the cycle.** Every in-world theory is wrong or incomplete. See Layer 5 in `33_MYSTERIES.md`.

### Why Seeps look absurd

> CANON: Undertow grammar has no concept of human relevance. A Seep's Rule optimizes for informational symmetry, not utility â€” hence stairs that count, elevators that remember, coins that always land on the year of your death. Absurdity is not a joke the universe tells; it is what alien consistency looks like from inside the Membrane.

## 3.2 HUMAN THEORIES (what people believe)

None of the following is fully true. All of them shape policy, which makes them load-bearing anyway.

| Theory | Held by | Core claim | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Membrane Theory** | Meridian Compact science directorate | Thin-reality / pressure model, ~70% accurate, wrong about the Tide's cause | `STATUS: THEORY` (closest to truth) |
| **The Mother Below** | The Drowned Choir | The Undertow is a dreaming goddess; the Tide is her waking; Drowning is salvation | `STATUS: THEORY` (theology) |
| **Quantum-cognitive model** | Vesper Pharma, several universities | Anomalies are observer-effect macro-events; consciousness collapses probability | `STATUS: THEORY` (useful for medicine, wrong overall) |
| **Demonic / djinn framework** | Various religious conservatives | Seeps are spirits; the Attuned are possessed or blessed | `STATUS: IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION` (morally loaded, predictively useless) |
| **Tulpa / belief theory** | Fringe researchers, some Lantern Bearers | Human belief creates Seeps | `STATUS: IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION` â€” with a grain of truth: strong collective attention can slightly *shape* a Seep's Rule expression, never create one |
| **Extraterrestrial hypothesis** | Popular conspiracy culture | Seeps are alien technology | `STATUS: IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION` |
| **Simulation hypothesis** | Tech-sector fringe | Reality is computed; Seeps are glitches | `STATUS: THEORY` (unfalsifiable; believed by some Halcyon engineers) |
| **Karmic / ancestral models** | Folk traditions (esp. archipelagic SE Asia) | Seeps are ancestor-pressure, *buta-kala* restlessness, unbalanced offerings | `STATUS: THEORY` (folk; occasionally correlates because old communities learned genuine containment heuristics by trial and error) |

> CANON: Folk containment heuristics are often *practically* effective even when their theory is wrong â€” three hundred years of "don't whistle on that stairwell" is data, not superstition. The Compact quietly archives folk practices as phenomenological field reports.

## 3.3 Seep taxonomy (by substrate)

> CANON: Every anomaly is one (rarely two) of:

- **Object Seeps** â€” items with Rules (the Laggard's class, loosely). Most common; most containable.
- **Place Seeps** â€” locations with Rules (the stairwell that counts; the intersection that replays Tuesdays).
- **Organism Seeps** â€” living things with Rules (the cat that is always found, the tree that fruits other people's lost keys).
- **Event Seeps** â€” phenomena with Rules (the rain that falls upward on the third Thursday; the blackout that whispers).
- **Information Seeps** â€” data with Rules: cognitohazards, self-propagating patterns, images that cannot be correctly remembered. Rarest, most feared, hardest to contain â€” you cannot put a fact in a vault.

## 3.4 Static rot

> CANON: Undertow-structured information does not persist cleanly in Membrane media. Recordings of active Seeps corrupt at a rate proportional to Tide pressure â€” "static rot." Consequences:
- A T1's trick films fine; a T5 event melts sensors.
- Written notes survive better than video; human Loud memory survives best of all â€” which is why **witnesses are worth more than footage** and why Arthur (perfect Loud recall) is valuable.
- Rot is *why* the internet hasn't ended the masquerade: the most convincing events are the least recordable.

# 04 â€” POWER SYSTEM (The Attuned)

## 4.1 Emergence

> CANON: An Attuned is made, not born â€” but some are born far more likely to be made.

- **The Hollow Pattern** (cortical folding variant) occurs in ~1/5,000 people. Carriers who are also Loud can be **Awakened**.
- **Awakening** ("First Tide") requires a trigger: trauma, near-death, or direct Seep exposure. ~60% of carriers never Awaken; they live ordinary lives, sometimes with lifelong dÃ©jÃ  vu and a talent for noticing wrong things.
- **Inheritance:** children of Attuned carry the pattern ~40% of the time and Awaken ~30Ã— more often than baseline â€” but Awakening still needs a trigger, and many Attuned parents deliberately raise children *away* from triggers. Dynasties exist (the Pale Court) but are fragile: every generation must survive its own First Tide.
- **No artificial Awakening** has ever worked reliably. Every attempt to mass-produce Attuned (three known state programs, one corporate) ended in Drownings. This is CANON and load-bearing: armies of super-soldiers are impossible.

## 4.2 The Five Disciplines

> CANON: Every Resonance falls into one discipline â€” the "shape" of the channel. Discipline determines what *kind* of Rule the Attuned can impose, never the scale.

| Discipline | Domain | Example (weak â†’ strong) | Regulation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **LANTERN** | Perception, information, memory | Sense Tide pressure â†’ read Tide-marks of a room â†’ track a person by their "wake" | Lightest; Lanterns staff detection, forensics, journalism |
| **TIDE** | Matter and energy | Warm a cup â†’ shatter concrete â†’ (T5+) weather-scale events | Heavy; Tide combat licenses are the most restricted |
| **BONE** | Body and self | Accelerated healing â†’ physical augmentation â†’ (T5+) regeneration | Medical licensing; sports bans |
| **CHOIR** | Social influence, suggestion | Calm a room â†’ seed a suggestion â†’ (T4+) crowd-scale emotional steering | **Most regulated discipline on earth.** Direct mind control is impossible (02.I), but Choir is close enough to terrify legislators. Unlicensed Choir use = prison in 140+ countries. **Choir use in elections and referenda is an Accords/Tribunal offense** ([14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md) 14.3); campaigns in signatory states are Lantern-monitored |
| **HOLLOW** | Direct Undertow interfacing | Sense thin places â†’ briefly "wade" (partial phase) â†’ Slipping | Rarest (~3% of Attuned); monitored by every intelligence agency; most Hollow work is state-monopolized |

> CANON: Discipline is fixed at Awakening. No one changes discipline. (What looks like "versatility" is always clever application within one discipline.)

## 4.3 Tiers T0â€“T7

> CANON: Tier measures *maximum sustainable output*, not skill, not danger, not Erosion rate.

| Tier | Name | Capability ceiling | Approx. global population |
|---|---|---|---|
| T0 | **Quiet** | No channeling (ordinary humans, unawakened carriers) | ~8 billion |
| T1 | **Spark** | Party tricks; inconvenient or minor utility | ~800,000 |
| T2 | **Lantern** | Professional-grade; the working class of the hidden world | ~90,000 |
| T3 | **Surge** | Can decide a firefight or a boardroom; registered, watched | ~8,000 |
| T4 | **Tempest** | National asset / national threat; Seismograph-visible | ~700 |
| T5 | **Cataclysm** | City-scale consequences; every use is a geopolitical event | ~40 |
| T6 | **Worldtide** | Continental consequences; three confirmed alive | 3 confirmed |
| T7 | **Unknown** | Reserved for "we don't know what that was" | 0 confirmed; the designation exists because it has been needed |

> CANON: Tier is *not* destiny in a fight. A prepared T2 with knowledge, terrain, and the right countermeasure routinely survives â€” sometimes defeats â€” a T4. (Mechanics in `30_POWER_HIERARCHY.md`.) Raw tier wins *unprepared* encounters; preparation is the great equalizer, which is why intelligence is the true currency.

## 4.4 Erosion (the cost)

> CANON: Channeling is priced in **Fathoms** (0â€“100), a clinical scale maintained by the Compact's medical directorate. Colloquially: *"How deep are you?"*

- **Cost curve:** output scales linearly; Erosion scales *exponentially* past ~40 Fathoms. A T2 can work daily for years at low Fathoms. A T5 pushing maximum output can go from 60 to Drowning in a single afternoon.
- **Routine rates (CANON):** ordinary low-output channeling â€” a working day's worth of small uses â€” accrues roughly **0.005â€“0.02 Fathoms/day**, depending on discipline, output, and rest. A career Attuned budgets on the order of **~5 Fathoms/year** for routine work; *serious* uses (combat output, deep Lantern reads, long Slips) are rationed individually against the lifetime budget, because one bad afternoon can cost more than a decade of careful days. This is the arithmetic behind every pension, every retention bonus, and every "past 45 Fathoms, everyone buys continuity" ([08_ECONOMY.md](08_ECONOMY.md) 8.4).
- **Side effects by depth:** <20: nosebleeds, migraines. 20â€“40: memory gaps, emotional flattening, sleep disorders. 40â€“60: personality erosion ("the thinning"), Veil weakening (the Attuned starts *remembering too much*, including things that never happened to them â€” Tide-mark bleed). 60â€“80: identity instability, involuntary channeling, physical wrongness (reflections lag, shadows misbehave). 80â€“100: pre-Drowning. There is no coming back from 100.
- **Erosion is irreversible** (02.I). Stillness practices (the Quiet Garden's disciplines), Stillwater-class drugs, and rest *slow* further accumulation. Nothing reverses it.
- **The cruel arithmetic:** the most powerful Attuned are on the shortest clocks. T5s rarely live past 50. This is why there is no superhuman ruling class â€” power is a terminal condition.
- **The career budget (CANON):** ~5 Fathoms/year of routine work Ã— 20 years = the Drowning line â€” so the Compact's agencies do not let careers run that math. The **relief-rotation system** caps career accumulation at ~60 Fathoms: operators approaching the cap are rotated to non-channeling postings (training, archives, liaison â€” the "garden leave" track), and mandatory stand-down years are priced into every staffing model. Depth pay (08_ECONOMY.md) hedges the residual risk; the pension system ([08_ECONOMY.md](08_ECONOMY.md) 8.4: "past 45 Fathoms, everyone buys continuity") is the actuarial expression of the same budget. A T2 who works clean and rotates on schedule retires; a T2 who doesn't is a case study.

## 4.5 Training, detection, suppression

- **Training:** academies (see `15_EDUCATION.md`) teach *efficiency* â€” achieving effects at minimum Fathoms â€” and *discipline hygiene* (never channel angry, tired, or grieving). The best-trained T2 outperforms an untrained T3 at lower cost.
- **Detection:** the **Seismograph network** (Compact-operated, ~2,000 stations) detects Tide-pressure events â‰¥T3 globally within minutes. Lantern-sensitives and Hollow-pattern MRI screening handle the small scale. Several countries screen newborns; several others ban it as a human-rights violation â€” a live political fault line.
- **Suppression:** **Stillwater** drugs (dampen channeling; side effects: emotional blunting), **Anchor restraints** (Hollow-pattern-disrupting cuffs), warded containment cells (architectural Seep-suppression; expensive; the reason secret facilities are built like temples).
- **Countermeasures (why militaries still matter):** most Attuned are T1â€“T2; a rifle still kills a T2. Erosion limits sustained combat â€” a T4 cannot fight an army, only *survive* it briefly and expensively. **Drowndust** munitions (Erosion-inducing particulates â€” processed Drowning-site residue; mechanics and strategic doctrine in [13_MILITARY.md](13_MILITARY.md)) exist, are banned by the Meridian Accords, and are stockpiled anyway by at least four states. Conventional forces remain relevant because *endurance beats peak output* in every engagement longer than ninety seconds.

## 4.6 Hard limits per power type (CANON-LOCKED restatements with mechanics)

- **Resurrection:** impossible. Echoes are not people (02.I).
- **Teleportation (Slipping):** Hollow discipline only; arrival requires recognition (another living person's memory â€” not your own, not an echo); recognition decays with time; cost scales with distance/unfamiliarity; warded zones shred arrivals, hardened wards shred all non-whitelisted arrivals. No combat-blinking across continents.
- **Time:** causal bubbles only â€” line-of-sight scale, minutes at most, ruinous Erosion. No past alteration, ever.
- **Mind control:** impossible directly; suggestion seeding only, resistible, with backlash (02.I). Choir T5s can steer crowds emotionally â€” which is why Choir licensing is the strictest law in the hidden world.
- **Power copying:** requires consuming the source's pattern (murder by Drowning-adjacent ritual); the thief's Erosion accelerates catastrophically. Net loss, always. There are no power-sponges walking around with forty abilities. (There are three corpses in Compact vaults that prove why.)

> CANON: **The arithmetic of the theft.** The thief **inherits the victim's accumulated Fathoms** (the stolen pattern arrives pre-eroded) **and** the thief's own future accumulation rate **doubles** (the pattern was never theirs; the Membrane keeps trying to reject it). Stealing a 40-Fathom pattern means starting at 40 with a 2Ã— burn rate.
- **Matter creation:** borrowed matter reverts â‰¤72h (02.I). Conjured weapons work for a fight, not a war.
- **Healing:** Bone-discipline healing *accelerates* the body's own repair â€” it cannot regrow what the pattern no longer "remembers" (old amputations fail), cannot cure Erosion, and aggressive healing *transfers* Erosion-risk to the healer. There is no free hospital of miracles.
- **Reality warping:** there is no general-purpose "rewrite reality" discipline. The closest is Hollow T6 â€” and the three confirmed Worldtides are all under permanent Compact observation, all past 70 Fathoms, all dying by inches.

## 4.7 Ability interactions

> CANON: Resonances interact through **Rule interference**, not power levels. A Lantern T2 who knows a Tide T4's Rule can *spoil* the channeling conditions (break line-of-sight, flood the area with Tide-noise, trigger the Rule's exception clause). This is the mechanical basis of "the weak defeating the strong": **powers have conditions, and conditions can be attacked.** The protagonist's entire survival strategy is built on this fact.

## 4.8 Pre-Drowning (T6) doctrine

> CANON: The Compact's T6 doctrine is short because T6 is. A pre-Drowned Attuned (81â€“100 Fathoms) is placed on **mandatory relief rotation** (no channeling, no stressful postings â€” the doctrine's euphemism is "garden leave"), under **Drowning watch**: a two-person Lantern detail, continuous Seismograph flagging, and a standing Sweeper standby for the Drowning itself (the watch is not for the person; it is for everyone near them when the person goes). At 95+ Fathoms the detail becomes a containment team and the subject is moved to a warded facility â€” SITE-009's Liwanag wing handles the Pacific caseload. **There is no doctrine for 100**, because there is no one left to apply it to: the Drowning *is* the doctrine. Three confirmed Worldtides live past 70 Fathoms under permanent observation; none has ever come back down. (Arthur's ratchet climbs *toward* this band â€” the endgame's physics is the Drowning watch with his name on it. The parallel is institutional, not physical: Arthur accrues no Fathoms â€” the ratchet is measured in lag-seconds, a property of the tether, not Erosion â€” but at high lag the Compact will watch him the way it watches the pre-Drowned, because a man holding a lengthening window onto the Undertow presents the same attention economics as a man dissolving into it.)

# 05 â€” ANOMALY CLASSIFICATION (The Meridian Vector)

> CANON: Every anomaly handled by a signatory state or the Compact is described in a five-axis **Meridian Vector**. The vector is the hidden world's common language â€” the thing a Jakarta Sweeper, a Geneva arbitrator, and a reinsurance actuary all mean when they say "we have a problem."

## 5.1 The vector, defined

**Notation:** `MV-[THREAT]/[CONTAINMENT]-[FLAGS]/[RANGE]/[INTEL]`

Example: `MV-T3/C-C/I+R/Urban/Reactive` â€” a Threat-3 anomaly, contained-at-cost, carrying infohazard and reality-distortion flags, urban in range, reactive but non-sapient.

### Axis 1 â€” THREAT (T0â€“T7)

> CANON: Threat uses the same T-scale as Attuned tiers (see [Power System](04_POWER_SYSTEM.md)) â€” deliberately. It measures **maximum demonstrated output equivalent**: what tier of Attuned would be needed to match what the anomaly just did. It measures output, not malice, not Erosion, not cleverness.

A T1 object that always points north is filed T0 (no meaningful output). A T2 place-seep that rearranges exits is T2. The scale is retrospective and revisable upward â€” vectors are living documents, re-audited on triggers (see 5.5).

### Axis 2 â€” CONTAINMENT (Aâ€“E)

| Class | Meaning | Typical cost |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | Contained, stable. Passive measures suffice (a vault, a locked room, a warning sign the locals obey). | Negligible |
| **B** | Containable with known active procedures. Routine staffing, scheduled maintenance. | Budgeted |
| **C** | Contained **at cost**. Continuous active intervention: rotating teams, ward maintenance, Stillwater dosing, community management. | Significant, ongoing |
| **D** | Uncontained but **tracked**. Free in the wild; monitored; response on standby. | Surveillance + readiness |
| **E** | Uncontainable by any known means. Mitigation and evacuation only. | Whatever it takes |

> CANON: Containment class is orthogonal to Threat. A T5 can be class A (a city-killer asleep in a vault) and a T1 can be class E (a harmless rumor that cannot be un-known). Budget fights are almost always about the C-class middle: expensive enough to hurt, common enough to multiply.

> CANON (Classification Office policy, **person-bound filings**): where the anomaly is bound to a living person, the containment class describes the *relationship*, not the object â€” a person cannot be "uncontained," so person-bound anomalies are filed **C-A by default** even when the effort looks D-class (mobile, tracked, response on standby). The Laggard's `C-A` is this policy, not a cover-up: BPF Jakarta files it A, staffs it D, and the file carries a standing 5-year re-audit trigger precisely because the classification and the effort disagree. Auditors are trained to read person-bound C-A as *"contained for now, watched like it's loose"* â€” the policy's own guidance note. (Old-notation guidance: pre-Compact and pre-1962 files may use the BPF/colonial single-letter notation â€” treat any single-letter containment grade in an old file as approximate and re-file before citing.)

### Axis 3 â€” Hazard flags

Flags compose freely. An anomaly can carry none, one, or several.

| Flag | Meaning | Handling consequence |
|---|---|---|
| **I** | **Infohazard.** Knowledge of the anomaly is itself dangerous. | Need-to-know compartmentalization; possession of I-material is a crime in most signatories (see [Law Enforcement](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md)) |
| **B** | **Biohazard.** Affects living tissue / spreads biologically. | Medical-directorate protocols; quarantine authority |
| **P** | **Psychohazard.** Attacks cognition, identity, or sanity without being "information" per se. | Rotation limits for exposed staff; Quiet-care mandatory |
| **R** | **Reality distortion.** Locally rewrites physical law (borrowed matter, causal bubbles, spatial wrongness). | Warded containment required; Lantern survey before approach |
| **M** | **Memetic.** Propagates through imitation, culture, media â€” behaves like an idea with a Rule. | Memetic-range assessment mandatory; noise-farming countermeasures |
| **V** | **Vector / propagating.** Actively spreads itself (not merely carried). | Highest response priority within its threat band |

> CANON: The **V flag** was added in 2014 after the Ward Six reclassification (see 5.6, case 4). Before that, propagating anomalies were filed under M and consistently under-resourced.

### Axis 4 â€” RANGE

**Local** (a room, a building, a vehicle) â†’ **Urban** (a city or metro area) â†’ **Regional** (a province, an island group, a river basin) â†’ **Continental** â†’ **Global** â†’ **Memetic** (geography is irrelevant; it moves through information networks).

> CANON: **Memetic** range is not "worse than Global" â€” it is *differently shaped*. A Memetic-range T2 can be harder to contain than a Continental-range T4, because you cannot evacuate an idea. This is the single most common intuition failure among new analysts.

### Axis 5 â€” INTEL (None / Reactive / Sapient / Unknown)

- **None:** no detectable response to stimuli. Most object seeps.
- **Reactive:** responds to stimuli in fixed, non-novel ways (the stair counts; the fog arrives on schedule).
- **Sapient:** demonstrates novel problem-solving, communication, or negotiation. Triggers the **Sapient protocols** (2017 Accords): rules of engagement change, the Tribunal's remit extends, and â€” in one jurisdiction â€” asylum becomes possible (see [Governments](06_GOVERNMENTS.md), GOV-010).
- **Unknown:** insufficient data. **Treated as Sapient for rules of engagement until disproven** â€” the Sapient-presumption protocol, adopted after the Oslo case (5.6).

## 5.2 Why classification exists

Classification is not science for science's sake. It is load-bearing infrastructure, and it exists for four buyers:

1. **Resource triage.** Containment capacity is finite: warded vaults, Sweeper teams, Stillwater supplies, Lantern examiners. The vector is the language of the annual budget. A C-class anomaly costs roughly 40Ã— a B-class one; the difference between filing C-B and C-C is a staffing decision with a salary attached. Every misclassification is, downstream, somebody's overtime or somebody's funeral. The corps-level arithmetic â€” headcount, event volumes, the cost curve, the voted-down funding gap â€” is tabulated in [26_INFORMATION_CONTROL.md](26_INFORMATION_CONTROL.md) (classified).
2. **Legal triggers.** Accords obligations attach to vector thresholds, not to vibes:

| Threshold | Trigger |
|---|---|
| T3+ or C-D+ | Report to the Compact Classification Office within 72 hours |
| T4+ or Range â‰¥ Regional | Joint Containment Command placed on standby; Seismograph Authority notified |
| I flag | Infohazard protocols; possession criminalized in signatory law |
| V flag | Response priority within threat band; cross-border notification |
| INTEL: Sapient (or Unknown) | Sapient rules of engagement; Tribunal remit; asylum law engaged |

3. **Insurance.** Quiet Insurance is underwritten on vectors. [Meridian Re](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) (CORP-004) reinsures on vector bands; a C-class Urban anomaly within 5 km raises commercial premiums measurably. Arthur's employer, [Nusantara Quiet Assurance](06_GOVERNMENTS.md) (CORP-011), prices every policy it sells against the national vector register. The vector is, among other things, a price tag.
4. **Jurisdiction.** Vectors decide who leads: below T3/C-C, the national agency; above it, the Compact can assert concurrent jurisdiction; at T4+/Regional+, the [Joint Containment Command](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) can take command. The [Ledger](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) requires registration of every anomaly at T2+/C-B+ or higher â€” which makes the vector also a property deed.

## 5.3 Who controls it

> CANON: The **Classification Office** of the [Meridian Compact](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) (Geneva) owns the standard: it defines the axes, ratifies vectors, and hears appeals. It does not do field classification.

Field classification works in three stages:

1. **Provisional (field team, 24 hours).** The responding Sweeper team files a provisional vector. It is valid for 30 days and carries legal force â€” which is why field teams are trained to file *up*, not down: over-classification wastes money; under-classification kills people.
2. **National mirror (7 days).** Each signatory's agency runs a classification bureau (the BTA's Office of Threshold Taxonomy, the Jade Office's Classification Section, the BPF'sâ€¦ two overworked analysts in Jakarta) that confirms or amends.
3. **Compact ratification (30 days).** The Classification Office ratifies, amends, or remands. Its decisions are binding on signatories and appealable only to the Compact Arbitration Court â€” a process that takes years, during which the amended vector stands.

**The structural tension:** states systematically **under-classify** to avoid reporting obligations (sovereignty cost, Compact oversight) and systematically **over-classify** when they want to seize an asset (a T4/C-D filing justifies seizure without compensation in most jurisdictions). The Classification Office exists largely to arbitrate these two opposite lies. Its auditors are the most hated and most necessary people in the hidden world.

## 5.4 How vectors are born, live, and die

- **Birth:** provisional filing within 24h of first response.
- **Re-audit triggers (mandatory):** any new behavior outside the filed Rule description; any range expansion; any intel upgrade (Reactive â†’ Sapient); any cross-substrate discovery (a Place Seep found to have an Information component); every 5 years for C-class and above.
- **Death:** decommissioning (the seep's Rule ends â€” rare, usually by Drowning of a bound Attuned or destruction of the substrate) or reclassification to T0/C-A (dormant). Decommissioned vectors are archived, never deleted â€” the Compact has never once been embarrassed by keeping an old file.

   *One of the few E-class filings on earth. No known containment; mitigation is evacuation planning and a permanent JCC watch. INTEL: Unknown â€” and under the Sapient-presumption protocol, approached as Sapient.*
10. **ANOMALY-030 "The Second Silence Archive"** â€” `MV-T5/C-C/I/Memetic/Sapient`
    *Contained at cost: the archive is cooperative (Sapient) but I-flagged, so every researcher is compartmentalized, examined, and rotated. The most expensive library card in history.*

## 5.6 How classification goes wrong (case studies)

> CANON: The Classification Office publishes a redacted *Misclassification Review* every five years. The following are the most-cited entries. Competence is distributed (see [World Rules](02_WORLD_RULES.md)) â€” these were not stupid people. They were people with incentives, deadlines, and incomplete data, which is worse.

**Case 1 â€” Under-classification: the Surabaya Ledger (CASE-006).**
In 2017 a BPF field team filed a market place-seep in Surabaya as `MV-T1/C-A`: stalls whose goods rearranged overnight, a nuisance. It was actually an **Information Seep** riding the market's credit-ledger software â€” every bookkeeping file that recorded the rearranged inventory carried a fragment of the Rule, and the fragments propagated through accounting software across Java. Fourteen people died when a warehouse's inventory system "reconciled" its human staff. Re-audit put it at `MV-T3/C-C/I+V/Regional/Reactive`. Consequences: the BPF's regional budget was cut 30% (punishing the underfunded for being underfunded â€” the Office's critics still cite this), the classification chief resigned, and the **cross-substrate rule** was adopted: any C-flagged Place Seep with a transactional substrate gets automatic Information-component review. Director-General Ratna Kusuma (CHAR-005) still opens budget meetings with the Surabaya slide.

**Case 2 â€” Over-classification as seizure: Halvorsen v. BTA (CASE-001).**
In 1992 the BTA filed a Minnesota family's inherited Object Seep â€” a teacup that refilled with lukewarm tea, genuinely `MV-T1/C-A` â€” as `MV-T4/C-D`, justifying warrantless seizure under emergency powers. The family sued. Nine years of litigation established that (a) the BTA had no evidence for the T4 filing, (b) the filing officer's emails showed budget-justification motives, and (c) the teacup was, in the court's words, "a teacup." Consequences: the **Classification Appeals Panel** (any owner can challenge a vector within 90 days), mandatory evidence standards for filings above T2, and $4.1M in damages. Every BTA classifier is still shown the teacup's file on their first day. The lesson the Compact draws: *over-classification is also a lie, and lies compound.*

**Case 3 â€” INTEL misclassification: the Oslo Underpass (1988).**
A place-seep under Oslo's central station was filed `Reactive`: signage that changed to direct pedestrians away from maintenance areas. For six years the containment team treated signage changes as hazard escalation and responded with ward-burns â€” aggressive suppression. In 1992 a Lantern examiner proved the signage had been **negotiating**: it was trying to establish a schedule, and the ward-burns read as attacks. It retaliated. The underpass was lost; three staff Drowned; the site is now `MV-T4/C-E/R/Urban/Sapient` and a permanent exclusion zone. Consequences: the **Sapient-presumption protocol** â€” INTEL:Unknown is approached as Sapient until disproven â€” and the standing rule that *no suppression action is taken against an INTEL:Unknown anomaly without a Lantern examiner's sign-off.* The Oslo file is why "Unknown" exists as a category at all.

**Case 4 â€” RANGE misclassification: the Ward Six Lullaby (ANOMALY-007).**
Filed in 2007 as `MV-T3/C-C/I/Urban/Reactive`: a hospital-lullaby infohazard, contained to one city's care homes. In 2012 a Lantern examiner recognized the melody â€” sampled, pitch-shifted â€” in a charting pop song. It had been propagating through audio for five years. Reclassification to `MV-T4/C-D/I+M+V/Memetic/Reactive` required inventing two new pieces of the standard: the **V flag** and the **Memetic range**. Consequences: the Compact's audio-fingerprint screening program, mandatory M-flag review for all I-flag filings, and the auditors' proverb: *"Urban is a hope, not a measurement."*

## 5.7 What the vector doesn't capture (known gaps)

> STATUS: THEORY (Classification Office internal position, 2022 review): the vector underweights **interaction effects** â€” two T2s whose Rules interfere can produce T4 consequences (see [Power System](04_POWER_SYSTEM.md) on Rule interference). A composite-vector proposal has been tabled three times and defeated three times, each time on cost grounds: the current system is wrong in known ways, and everyone prefers known wrong to unknown expensive.

> CANON: Arthur Reed's day job is vectors. As a records clerk at Nusantara Quiet Assurance, he files, cross-references, and redacts Meridian Vectors all night. He knows the system the way a bank clerk knows money: intimately, cynically, and from the paperwork side. This is why he survives later â€” he has read ten thousand vectors, and he knows exactly what a wrong one looks like.

# 06 â€” GOVERNMENTS

> CANON: Every signatory state runs its own hidden-world apparatus, and no two work alike. The [Meridian Accords](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) set floors â€” secrecy, reporting, a Census â€” not ceilings. What follows is how fourteen states actually do it: their agencies, their incentives, and the internal fights that shape their behavior more than any treaty does.

Design note for the novel: Arthur lives inside the **British** system. SMD (GOV-006) jurisdiction is his daily reality â€” its Census, its inspectors, its forms, its precariat gap. BPF (GOV-004) is the agency of Yusuf's world: the pragmatism in the logbook's margins â€” triage, community partnerships, annotated field manuals â€” the lens Arthur inherited with the tether. It is not his system; it is his *inheritance*. The other thirteen exist so that when foreigners enter his story, they arrive with *different rulebooks* â€” which is where most cross-border conflict comes from.

## COUNTRY-005 â€” United States

**Government:** Federal presidential republic.

**Agency: GOV-001 â€” Bureau of Threshold Affairs (BTA).** Independent agency; Director confirmed by the Senate, reporting to the President through the National Security Council.

- **Origin:** Stitched together in the 1977 Accords revision from three parents: a DARPA research program ("Project Lantern"), an FBI domestic desk, and FEMA's disaster framework. The stitching never fully healed â€” the BTA still has three internal cultures that barely speak to each other.
- **Leadership:** Director **Elena Voss** (CHAR-002), second term. Former VP of Halcyon Dynamics (CORP-001). The revolving door is not a scandal here; it is the staffing model.
- **Ideology:** *Managed outsourcing.* The state sets standards, writes contracts, and buys outcomes. Containment is a service; liability is a product; everything the BTA does directly, it does because no contractor would take the risk at any price.
- **Resources:** The largest hidden-world budget on earth. Roughly 40% flows to contractors: Halcyon Dynamics (containment hardware), Obsidian Relay (CORP-005, secure comms), Pale Lantern Media (CORP-006, noise-farming contracts â€” the BTA is the single largest buyer of fake paranormal content on the internet).
- **Methods:** Licensed Sweeper franchises (private teams with federal charters), aggressive Lantern forensics, and procedure for everything â€” the BTA will get a warrant-shaped piece of paper before it kicks down a door, and it has a form for the door.
- **Anomaly policy:** Register and contain; seizure with compensation (post-[CASE-001](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md), the BTA pays â€” slowly, but it pays). Private ownership of T1/C-A anomalies is legal with a license; everything above is state custody.
- **Attuned policy (Census):** The **Threshold Registry**. Mandatory for T3+, for Tide/Choir/Hollow disciplines regardless of tier, and for federal employment. Otherwise voluntary â€” but unregistered Attuned cannot buy Quiet insurance, hold federal jobs, or obtain Tide-combat licenses, which makes "voluntary" do a lot of work. Compliance â‰ˆ 55%.
- **Secrets:** (1) A Drowndust stockpile held through a contractor cutout, legally deniable and practically real â€” the Compact's worst-verified open secret. (2) A gray procurement program that buys anomalies off the Gray Markets (via Ash Exchange, CRIM-003, cutouts) â€” officially to keep them out of worse hands; the auditors note the BTA's vaults keep growing. (3) The franchise program's incident reports are systematically under-filed; the BTA knows and accepts it as the cost of the model.
- **Internal conflicts:** Federal vs. state â€” Texas and California run near-independent "quiet desks" that share data upward only when sued; the civil-liberties bar (the "Loud Rights Project" and three Supreme Court cases) vs. the security directorate; the contracting office vs. everyone (three fraud scandals in a decade, all settled, none reformed).
- **Differs from the others:** The only system where the masquerade is a public-private partnership, and the most litigated system on earth â€” Americans sue the hidden world the way they sue everything else.

## COUNTRY-002 â€” China

**Government:** One-party socialist state.

**Agency: GOV-002 â€” The Jade Office** (çŽ‰åŠž, YÃ¹bÃ n â€” named for the imperial seal-stone; it claims lineage from the Ming "Bureau of Inauspicious Affairs," and its archivists can prove about half of that). Ministry-grade, under the State Council.

- **Origin:** The imperial lineage is partly ceremonial; the modern Office was built 1949â€“1957 as a Party organ, professionalized in the 1980s, and digitized aggressively after 2008.
- **Leadership:** Commissioner **Zhao Mingde** (CHAR-003), career cadre, third generation. His grandmother was a village practitioner of exactly the kind the Office now archives â€” a fact his rivals mention often and he never disputes.
- **Ideology:** *Stability through total legibility.* The Attuned are not threats or assets; they are **human resources**, like engineers. Everyone has a file, a post, and a pension. The hidden world is administered the way the power grid is administered.
- **Resources:** The largest personnel count of any agency; the densest Seismograph hosting network; neighborhood-committee reporting that reaches every urban block.
- **Methods:** Birth screening (Hollow-pattern MRI at birth â€” China is one of the few states that does this openly), mandatory Awakening reporting within 72 hours, Attuned organized into work units with ranks, housing, and career tracks. Grid surveillance means most channeling is detected before it is reported.
- **Anomaly policy:** State monopoly. Private possession of any anomaly above T0 is a crime. Folk containment practices are archived by field teams â€” respectfully, thoroughly, and then replaced.
- **Attuned policy (Census):** Mandatory, universal, birth-to-grave. Attuned serve in assigned posts (infrastructure, medicine, disaster response); Choir-licensed Attuned are restricted to supervised institutional roles. Compliance â‰ˆ 95% in cities, lower in the western provinces.
- **Secrets:** (1) The Office ran an experimental artificial-Awakening program â€” "Project Vermilion" (1989â€“1995). It never reached mass-production scale and ended in Drownings; it is not counted among the three known state programs ([24_HISTORY.md](24_HISTORY.md)). The files are sealed even from most of the Office; Zhao has read them and is the reason the Office now prosecutes Awakening experimentation harder than any other state. (2) A hardliner faction maintains a sealed proposal for "maintenance Stillwater dosing" of registered T3+ Attuned â€” chemical leashing, never approved, never quite killed. (3) A Drowndust stockpile â€” one of the four the Compact assesses (see [13_MILITARY.md](13_MILITARY.md) 13.3); unacknowledged by Beijing and held outside the Office's own ledgers.
- **Internal conflicts:** Hardliners (the Attuned as latent threats; the Office as a cage) vs. integrationists (Zhao's camp: the Attuned as civil servants; the Office as an employer). Plus the permanent friction with folk and minority-region networks whose heuristics the Office wants to archive and whose autonomy it wants to end â€” the same tension, running for seventy years.
- **Differs from the others:** The only system that treats the Attuned as a **labor category** rather than a threat category. The BTA buys containment; the Jade Office *staffs* it.

## COUNTRY-003 â€” Russia

**Government:** Federal semi-presidential republic, highly centralized.

**Agency: GOV-003 â€” Department 12** (ÐžÑ‚Ð´ÐµÐ»-12). Under the General Staff, with FSB liaison â€” **military-run**, the only great-power agency formally inside the armed forces.

- **Origin:** NKVD "Special Department 7" â†’ KGB â†’ the 1991â€“1999 **lost decade**, when half the Soviet vault network went unguarded and an uncounted number of anomalies walked into the Gray Markets (the Ash Exchange's founding inventory, the old hands say). Reconstituted from 2000 as a military organ on the theory that civilians had failed.
- **Leadership:** General **Arkady Volkov** (CHAR-004), GRU background. Erosion-skeptic: he has said, on record inside the building, that Drowning is "a failure of will." The Office's medical directorate keeps his Fathom count in a sealed file and prays he never channels.
- **Ideology:** *Strategic depth.* Anomalies are weapons, the Attuned are soldiers, and the hidden world is a theater of war that happens to be quiet.
- **Resources:** A vast inherited Soviet vault infrastructure (much of it decaying), a smaller budget than the US or China, and ruthless prioritization â€” Department 12 does fewer things and does them with overwhelming force.
- **Methods:** Containment by force, information blackouts, closed cities for major facilities. Negotiation is not in the manual; the manual has a chapter on ward-breaching instead.
- **Anomaly policy:** State seizure, no compensation, no appeals. What the Department holds, it holds.
- **Attuned policy (Census):** Mandatory military registration at Awakening; conscription into "special purpose units." Unregistered channeling is charged as the equivalent of desertion. Compliance is high because the penalty for non-compliance is the army.
- **Secrets:** (1) A Drowndust stockpile â€” the worst-kept secret in the Compact, confirmed by defector testimony the Department calls fabrication. (2) The **Saratov sleeper**: a T5 kept in medically induced coma as a "deterrent reserve." The Erosion economics are dubious, the medical directorate's objections are on file, and Volkov considers the file closed. (3) Decommissioned containment hardware sold through Vostok Brotherhood (CRIM-004) cutouts â€” the Department's off-books income.
- **Internal conflicts:** FSB vs. General Staff â€” a turf war older than most of the staff, fought over who controls the vault keys. Volkov vs. his own Lantern scientists, who warn that the sleeper program ends with a Drowning inside a closed city. The 1991 generation (who remember losing everything) vs. the Volkov generation (who intend never to lose anything again, at any price).
- **Differs from the others:** The only system that openly â€” internally â€” treats anomalies as a **strategic arsenal**, and the only one whose doctrine assumes the next war will be supernatural.

## COUNTRY-004 â€” Indonesia

**Government:** Presidential republic; post-1996 reformasi democracy.

**Agency: GOV-004 â€” BPF (Badan Penanganan Fenomena).** Civilian agency under the Coordinating Ministry for Political, Legal, and Security Affairs. Chronically underfunded â€” roughly 1/40th the BTA's per-capita coverage.

- **Origin:** A 1949 Accords signatory desk, buried inside intelligence through the authoritarian decades, reformed as a civilian agency in 1999. Three generations of staff, one generation of budget.
- **Leadership:** Director-General **Ratna Kusuma** (CHAR-005), career civil servant, former field Sweeper. Famous internally for the "bless what stays" memo (2017): *we cannot afford to contain everything, so we will contain what moves and bless what stays.*
- **Ideology:** *Pragmatic triage.* The BPF does not have the money for doctrine, so it has judgment instead.
- **Resources:** Thin. Sweeper work is contracted to Nusantara Quiet Assurance (CORP-011) â€” which is why Arthur's employer is effectively a BPF auxiliary. Compact capacity-building grants cover about a fifth of the field budget. What the BPF has in abundance: **archipelago seep geography** (17,000 islands on the Ring of Fire; tectonic stress is membrane stress; Indonesia has more Place Seeps per capita than anywhere but Albion) and **folk-heuristic integration** â€” formal liaison with Majelis Fenomena scholars (REL-003) and the Parisada working group (REL-004); village practitioners registered as "community containment auxiliaries" with stipends. Three hundred years of *don't whistle on that stairwell* is data, and the BPF treats it as data.
- **Methods:** Triage by pragmatism; community partnerships; insurance-led response (Quiet policies do half the cleanup work before the BPF arrives). The BPF's field manual is famously short and famously annotated in the margins.
- **Anomaly policy:** Community containment first; state containment for T3+ or anything that moves. Private ownership of T1/C-A anomalies is legal and common â€” half of Jakarta's old families have something in a drawer.
- **Attuned policy (Census):** **Pendataan Sukarela** â€” voluntary registration, incentivized by Quiet-insurance premium discounts. Compliance â‰ˆ 30%, the lowest among signatories. Unregistered Attuned are left alone unless they cause incidents â€” the BPF cannot afford to chase them and, institutionally, doesn't want to.
- **Secrets:** (1) The **sleeping ledger**: an off-books register of ~200 place-seeps that villages manage themselves and Jakarta pretends not to know about â€” plausible deniability if one wakes, community trust if none do. (2) The BPF quietly tolerates the Surabaya Gray Market rather than raiding it: monitoring is cheaper than enforcement, and the market's dealers report T4+ movement voluntarily (dealers hate surprises more than regulators do).
- **Internal conflicts:** Jakarta HQ vs. the regional offices that actually do the work and are tired of being audited by people who've never left Java. The Ministry of Religious Affairs vs. BPF methods it considers un-Islamic (the Majelis liaison exists partly to referee this). Reformers who want US-style contractorization vs. old hands who trust the village networks â€” the argument Ratna Kusuma mediates weekly.
- **Differs from the others:** The only system that formally **deputizes folk religion as containment infrastructure**. It is the system that made Yusuf Hidayat (CHAR-018) â€” the pragmatism in the logbook's margins; Arthur inherited the lens along with the tether. His daily reality is SMD jurisdiction (GOV-006).

## COUNTRY-001 â€” Albion

**Government:** Parliamentary constitutional monarchy; the **primary narrative country**.

**Agency: GOV-006 â€” Special Measures Division (SMD)**, Albion Cabinet Office. Small, elite, technocratic.

- **Origin:** Built under US occupation supervision to satisfy the 1949 Accords â€” originally an SCAP-monitored "public safety measures" desk with borrowed authority and no arrest powers of its own. **Albion was not a 1949 signatory** (it signed nothing in 1949; the occupation desk was compliance machinery, not accession): Albion acceded to the Accords in **1952** via a US-backed quiet arrangement that let the occupation-built desk become the national apparatus without a public treaty debate. Through the 1960sâ€“70s it lived inside Cabinet-adjacent intelligence structures, competent but invisible; the **1977 Quiet Night** exposed it â€” eleven minutes when Tokyo's transit system stopped between stations, the official story a power-grid fault, the Division's founding trauma. Rebuilt in the 1980s as a civilian elite on the theory that the occupation desk had been too small and too borrowed. **Rechartered 1995** as the Albion Cabinet Office's Special Measures Division after the 1994 Kobe-pressure audit forced the recharter: direct Cabinet-secretary authority, its own arrest powers, and the employer-Census statute. The 1995 charter is the Division's real birth certificate â€” everything before it was prologue.
- **Leadership:** A career director, rotated every three years by design â€” no one builds a fiefdom. The current director is a former transport-ministry official; the Division's real continuity sits with its deputy layer (operations, Census administration, liaison â€” the three deputies who outlast every director) and with the field chiefs. The three deputies head the Division's three arms â€” **Operations, Census Administration, Liaison** â€” and everything the street sees (field offices, quiet-desk examiner loans, liaison officers â€” [14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md) 14.1) reports through one of the three. The **Ravenhurst field office** (CITY-033) is the Division's sharp end: Ravenshire's coastline, tectonic stress, and port traffic put more first-responses through Ravenhurst than through Tokyo HQ, and the field chief is the Division's real operational head in all but title â€” a dynamic the Division's planners studied in the KNF's Liwanag office with professional interest â€” and the study left a paper trail: **SMD Internal Memorandum 19-04** ("Field-office autonomy in archipelagic jurisdictions," 2017, Liaison Arm archive), citing the KNF's Daungan deconfliction memos and the Division's own 2014 Ravenshire prefectural-loan audit as the two inputs to the Ravenhurst field office's standing orders. (The rotation was designed to prevent fiefdoms; its side effect is that the National Police Agency turf war â€” the 1995 charter's original sin â€” is never *resolved*, only inherited: every director arrives to a litigated line and leaves it litigated. The war is bureaucratic, not personal, and it outlives every director â€” which is the point.)
- **Ideology:** *Order as safety.* Anomalies are industrial-safety problems. The correct response to the impossible is a checklist. The Division's field manual is the thickest in the Compact; its after-action reviews are famous for finding the procedural failure inside every incident â€” including its own successes. Failure is data; undocumented failure is the only sin.
- **Resources:** Blackforge Heavy Industries (CORP-003) builds the Division's containment hardware under exclusive contract; Seismograph coverage is the densest per capita on earth; documentation standards are the envy of the Classification Office. Albion has the highest per-seep containment spend in Asia and the fewest D-class filings per capita. Headcount stays small by design â€” a few hundred career staff, the exact number classified â€” because the Division's theory is that a small agency with total paperwork beats a large agency with partial paperwork.
- **Methods:** **Employer-based Census** â€” your company registers you, monitors you, and is liable for you. Neighborhood-association (neighbourhood association) reporting. Koban-fed tip lines: patrol officers' standardized suspicious-person/object reports are auto-copied to the prefectural quiet desk, which copies the Division (see [Law Enforcement](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md) 14.1). Meticulous files: the Division's archive is the reason the Compact's re-audit standards exist. On the Ravenhurst waterfront the Division runs the **port protocol** â€” see the Blackwater Syndicate truce below.
- **Anomaly policy:** Contain everything, compensate generously, apologize publicly (in redacted form). Compensation is administered through employer channels â€” fast for the salaried, slow for everyone else, which is itself a quiet enforcement mechanism for the Census. The Division authored the **Fukushima Rule** (2011): some Tide-marks are too sacred to exploit (the treaty principle â€” the 2011 read-only principle), and some places can't be contained, only *managed around* (the exported manage-around doctrine) â€” one name, two meanings, both canonical; see [EVENT-070](25_TIMEmessaging app.md) and [RC-008](31_CONFLICT_ENGINE.md).
- **Attuned policy (Census):** Employer-mediated, effectively mandatory for the salaried class; the self-employed and precariat fall through the cracks (a known gap the Division under-studies). Choir users face lifetime bans from listed-company employment â€” social death by compliance. **The SSW precariat:** the employer-Census model assumes a responsible employer. Specified Skilled Worker migrants â€” Indonesian, Vietnamese, Filipino â€” are typically hired through multi-layer dispatch chains whose nominal sponsor is a small contractor that files Census paperwork late, partially, or not at all. Migrant Attuned sit in the gap: registered on paper at a dispatch company with no monitoring capacity, or unregistered when the chain breaks. The Loud aren't Census subjects at all â€” the Division's blind spot, because nobody files paperwork on people who merely remember. The Division knows about the gap; the gap is budgeted at zero. Arthur's file is cleaner than most citizens' â€” NQA's Ravenhurst branch files properly under its high-attention hiring policy â€” and it is an *original*: his Loud-flagged hire ([EVENT-087](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)) sits in the SMD's own quiet-desk drawer. The Division has the file; it has never understood the approver. The dispatch-layer reality means Division inspectors treat SSW Attuned as a compliance-risk class by default, and the Loud as a rumor class.
- **Secrets:** (1) A "retirement village" in the mountains that is half hospice, half prison for high-Fathom Attuned â€” humane, well-funded, and impossible to leave. (2) Quiet purchases of Tide-medicine from Vesper Pharmaceuticals (CORP-002) that never appear in the health ministry's books. (3) An unacknowledged SSW-worker watchlist compiled from dispatch-company filings â€” **tiered by Threshold-adjacency**: only migrants in Threshold-adjacent jobs (claims processing, containment logistics, records) are actively watched; the rest are filed and forgotten. The tiering is the doctrine's honest answer to the capacity gap â€” and the reason Arthur's records-clerk placement matters anyway: his job is Threshold-adjacent *by placement*, which is why the watched tier caught a citizen clerk at all, which is why the redacted approver ([EVENT-087](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)) put him there. The Division's private estimate is that the employer Census misses ~15% of the Attuned population, and it publishes no part of that number.
- **Internal conflicts:** The Division vs. the National Police Agency (which resents a Cabinet office with arrest powers â€” the 1995 charter's original sin; the working compromise is that the Division arrests on threshold grounds and hands ordinary criminal charges to the prefectural police, a line both sides litigate constantly). Younger Attuned staff pushing for rights reforms vs. an old guard that considers the current system a kindness. The precariat gap â€” everyone knows, no one budgets. **Ravenshire liaison friction:** the Ravenhurst field office borrows the prefectural quiet desk's Lantern examiners and never returns them on time; the prefectural police want their own arrest numbers, the Division wants the files first; the koban reports both chains read are the permanent turf. And the **Blackwater Syndicate waterfront truce**: the Division's port protocol is a written-but-unwritten understanding with Ravenhurst's waterfront syndicate â€” the Blackwater Syndicate keeps foreign operators and unlicensed Gray Market dealers off the piers, the Division aims its containment spend at the waterline seeps and doesn't ask about the rest. The Division's planners modeled it on the KNF's Daungan understanding, then did the one thing the KNF never could: wrote it down as "port security cooperation," audited annually. The prefectural police's organized-crime unit considers the truce a betrayal and says so, in writing, every year.
- **Differs from the others:** The most **bureaucratically complete** system â€” every seep has a form, every form has a file, every file is audited. The Division fails gracefully: when it misses something, the paperwork shows exactly where. It is now also Arthur's system â€” the one whose forms his branch files, whose inspectors he will meet, and whose blind spot he *is*.

## COUNTRY-006 â€” United Kingdom

**Government:** Parliamentary constitutional monarchy.

**Agency: GOV-007 â€” The Threshold Directorate** ("the Directorate"). The oldest continuous hidden-world agency on earth.

- **Origin:** The "Second Office" (1830s) â€” an imperial organ that spent a century **collecting** anomalies across the Empire. Half the [Ledger's](07_INTERNATIONAL_RELATIONS.md) oldest entries are British seizures, a live diplomatic sore the Directorate manages with tea and delay.
- **Leadership:** A titled director-general (the current one is a former diplomat). Real power sits with the archivists â€” the Directorate's institutional memory is its weapon.
- **Ideology:** *Quiet continuity.* The masquerade as imperial inheritance. "We have always done it this way" is not nostalgia; it is a risk assessment.
- **Resources:** A modest budget and an enormous archive â€” Tide-mark records, field reports back to the 1840s, the most complete pre-1949 practice library in existence. The Directorate knows things no one else bothered to write down.
- **Methods:** Work through the City â€” Argent Vault Bank (CORP-008) handles anomaly-asset finance under Directorate regulation; the Directorate itself stays small and well-informed. Old understandings with Attuned dynasties (the Pale Court, SUP-009, among others) do work that would cost millions if done officially.
- **Anomaly policy:** **Heritage model** â€” old anomalies are treated as Crown assets; new ones are assessed for the collection. Repatriation claims from former colonies are acknowledged, studied, and never quite resolved.
- **Attuned policy (Census):** The voluntary **Roll**. Strong social norms do the enforcement â€” in the circles that matter, being unregistered is simply not done. Unlicensed Choir use is prosecuted harshly (post-[CASE-002](14_LAW_ENFORCEMENT.md), the precedent every Commonwealth country cites).
- **Secrets:** (1) The colonial seizures it has never returned â€” the Directorate's lawyers have a standing brief, updated annually, for the day the claims become lawsuits. (2) A sealed 1977 file on what the Quiet Night did to London's Underground â€” the reason the Division-equivalent protocols exist, and the reason the file stays sealed.
- **Internal conflicts:** Post-Brexit fallout â€” the EU Concord Office (GOV-005) froze the UK out of shared Seismograph data tiers, and the Directorate is still rebuilding coverage. Devolved "quiet desks" in Scotland and Wales chafe at London control. Archivists vs. operators â€” the eternal fight between those who preserve and those who act.
- **Differs from the others:** The **archive**. Nobody knows more about how the hidden world was run before 1949, because nobody else kept the receipts.
