# 33 â€” MYSTERIES: The Five Layers

> CANON: This setting runs on **budgeted mystery** ([02_WORLD_RULES.md](02_WORLD_RULES.md)): five layers, each with a defined epistemic status. A mystery labeled INTENTIONAL is a *promise* to the reader. An unexplained gap relabeled as mystery is a *bug*. The final section lists things that are NOT mysterious â€” fully explained â€” to prove the distinction is real.

## L1 â€” What everyone believes (the public)

The 96â€“98% Quiet majority. Their world: ghosts aren't real, the weird videos are fake (correct â€” most are), "the Quiet" is a meme about forgetting why you walked into a room, the night the radios dreamed was a solar storm, Tunguska was a meteor, and the government is hiding *aliens*, which is almost endearingly wrong. They are wrong about nearly everything and *functionally right* about the conclusion: live your life, pay your rent, don't whistle on that stairwell.

> STATUS: IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION (as a total picture). Individually, L1 beliefs are the Veil working as designed.

## L2 â€” What experts believe (the Compact's Membrane Theory)

The Meridian Compact's science directorate, the academies (ACAD-001), Vesper's researchers, the better journalists:

- Reality is a thin Membrane over the Undertow; Seeps are pressure intrusions with fixed Rules; the Veil Reflex, static rot, and Erosion are measured facts.
- The Tide runs on a centuries cycle; we are entering a High Tide, the first since the 14th century; Seep frequency has tripled since 2000.
- There is **no adversary** â€” the Undertow does not want anything; there is no intelligent enemy, only pressure and human exploitation.
- The masquerade is strained but manageable with funding and the 2017 protocols.

> STATUS: THEORY â€” the closest human model, ~70% accurate. It is **wrong about the cause of the Tide** (it attributes the cycle to substrate mechanics it cannot observe) and it treats the no-adversary axiom as proven. It isn't. (See L5.)

## L3 â€” What secret orgs believe (each wrong in its own direction)

| Holder | Belief | Status |
|---|---|---|
| The Drowned Choir (SUP-001) | The Undertow is the Mother Below, dreaming; the Tide is her waking; Drowning is salvation, and the Chapel of the Deep is her altar | THEORY (theology); phenomenologically observant, theologically unprovable |
| The Pale Court (SUP-009) | Bloodlines are destiny; the Hollow Pattern is an inheritance to be curated; Loud lines are breeding stock | THEORY (eugenic; predictively weak â€” inheritance raises odds, guarantees nothing) |
| Halcyon Dynamics (CORP-001) | The simulation hypothesis â€” Seeps are computational glitches; with enough data, exploitable | THEORY (unfalsifiable; useful for engineering, empty for explanation) |
| Department 12 (GOV-003) | The phenomena are a weapons substrate like any other; the only questions are yield and delivery | IN-WORLD MISCONCEPTION as a total doctrine â€” Erosion makes every "weapon" single-use |
| The Ninth Bell (SUP-007) | The High Tide is the end of secrecy and the beginning of revelation; witness events will *force* the world's eyes open | THEORY (eschatology); the Lagos partial success (2023) is their first evidence |
| The Quiet Garden (SUP-003) | Stillness is the answer â€” the phenomena cannot be governed, only *outlasted* by the disciplined self | THEORY (praxis, not cosmology; the most empirically successful of the theologies) |
| The Cartographers (SUP-002) | Everything can be mapped, including the Undertow; the map is the territory's shadow | THEORY (methodological; Ilsa Brandt's journals are their scripture and their warning) |
| Vesper Pharma (CORP-002) | Erosion is a disease with a mechanism; mechanisms can be treated | THEORY (the most expensive bet in the hidden world; Nwosu's suppressed paper is its latest casualty) |

> CANON: Every L3 belief shapes policy, budgets, and body counts. Being wrong has never stopped anyone from being *effective* â€” the Choir's containment-adjacent rituals work, the Court's dynasties persist, Halcyon's engineers build. The novel's rule: **respect the praxis, doubt the cosmology.**

## L4 â€” What is actually happening (objective truth)

> CANON: The objective truth is [03_SUPERNATURAL_SYSTEM.md](03_SUPERNATURAL_SYSTEM.md) in full â€” stated here in compressed form because the mystery file must show what the layers *converge on*:

1. The Membrane/Undertow substrate model is **true**. Seeps are intrusions; Rules are alien but fixed; Tide-marks are viewable, never editable.
2. The Veil Reflex is a real cognitive immune response; Loudness is real (inborn or acquired); the Attuned are Loud Hollow-Pattern carriers awakened by trauma.
3. Erosion is real, irreversible, and the system's built-in ceiling. Drowning is pattern dissolution. Echoes are not people.
4. The Tide cycle is real; the High Tide is real; the pressure has tripled since 2000. **The Compact's model is wrong about what drives the cycle** â€” its substrate-mechanics account is a placeholder over an unknown.
5. The Laggard is a tether: the shadow of something in the Undertow standing where Arthur stands ([29_PROTAGONIST_ANOMALY.md](29_PROTAGONIST_ANOMALY.md)). This is author-level CANON.
6. The no-adversary axiom is **unproven**. Every expert believes it. Belief is not data. (See L5.)

> CANON: No living person knows all of L4. The closest any institution gets is the Compact's ~70% model â€” and the 30% it misses contains everything that matters most.

## L5 â€” The deepest truth (INTENTIONAL MYSTERIES)

> STATUS: UNKNOWN (author-level). The following are **deliberately undecided** â€” promises to the reader, not gaps. Each is marked with what would *resolve* it, so the story knows what it's looking for.

**L5-1 â€” What drives the Tide cycle?**
Every in-world theory is wrong or incomplete: substrate mechanics (Compact), the Mother Below's breathing (Choir), solar-system barycenter resonance (a Halcyon fringe), collective-attention feedback (post-2020 fashion). The 2020 dip-and-rebound proved *attention modulates pressure* â€” but modulation isn't a motor. *Resolution condition:* the story must eventually show the cycle's driver, or show *why it can't be shown*. Until then, no character speculates correctly on-page.

**L5-2 â€” What is the thing behind the Laggard, and is it intelligent?**
Something stands in the Undertow where Arthur stands. Its shadow renders 3 seconds late. It orients toward thin places. Deliberate use gets its *attention*. Crane's warning â€” *"waiting for its shadow to catch up"* â€” suggests something like anticipation. But anticipation isn't intelligence; a crystal "anticipates" geometry. *Resolution condition:* Arthur must eventually be in a position to *test* it â€” and the test must be his idea, earned, and dangerous. Whether it answers is the series' deepest hinge.

**L5-3 â€” Does the Undertow "want" anything?**
The no-adversary axiom is the hidden world's load-bearing belief â€” and it has never been *tested*, only *assumed*, because the alternative is unplannable. Note the tension: L5-2's entity displays attention-like behavior; attention-like isn't want-like; but a substrate without time or identity can't "want" in any Membrane sense â€” *unless want is the wrong word for what it does*. *Resolution condition:* the story may never fully resolve this; if it does, the resolution must recontextualize â€” not invalidate â€” eighty years of Compact doctrine.

**L5-4 â€” Why did the 2018 dip happen â€” what is the attention-pressure mechanism?**
Collective human stillness lowered Tide pressure for eighteen months. The correlation is solid; the mechanism is unknown. Is attention a *weight* on the Membrane? A *signal* the Undertow responds to? Or is the correlation backwards â€” did the pressure dip *cause* the stillness (a global micro-Veil event)? Nwosu's (CHAR-031) suppressed paper touched this; its suppression is itself data. *Resolution condition:* a testable mechanism, or proof the question is malformed.

**L5-5 â€” What was on Ilsa Brandt's torn-out last page?**
Her journals end one page early â€” deliberately removed, by her or by the Exchange. The page reportedly names *the ratchet's end*: what happens when the lag grows past some threshold. Three factions will pay anything for it (CG-048). *Resolution condition:* the page must surface in-story, and what it says must be *worse* than the bidding assumes â€” mysteries kept this long must pay off upward.

> CANON: L5 mysteries are a closed set. New intentional mysteries may be added only via CHANGELOG with coordinator approval. Everything else unexplained is a bug until labeled.

## NOT mysterious: fully explained (the distinction, proved)

The following are **not mysteries**. They have complete, in-bible explanations. They are listed here so the line between *promise* and *gap* stays visible:

1. **Why footage always fails.** Static rot, proportional to Tide pressure ([02_WORLD_RULES.md](02_WORLD_RULES.md), [03_SUPERNATURAL_SYSTEM.md](03_SUPERNATURAL_SYSTEM.md)). Documented since 1861 ([EVENT-017](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)). Not a mystery â€” a measurement.
2. **Why there are no Attuned armies.** Four mass-Awakening attempts, four piles of the Drowned ([EVENT-028](25_TIMEmessaging app.md), [04_POWER_SYSTEM.md](04_POWER_SYSTEM.md)). CANON. Not a mystery â€” a morgue.
3. **Why the masquerade held 1949â€“2000.** Seven interlocking facts ([01_CORE_PREMISE.md](01_CORE_PREMISE.md)), each built institutionally ([24_HISTORY.md](24_HISTORY.md)). Not a mystery â€” a budget.
4. **Why the strong don't rule.** Erosion's cruel arithmetic ([04_POWER_SYSTEM.md](04_POWER_SYSTEM.md), [30_POWER_HIERARCHY.md](30_POWER_HIERARCHY.md)). No god-kings because godhood is terminal. Not a mystery â€” an actuarial table.
5. **Why the Quiet Night didn't end the world.** The Long Quiet playbook: media freeze, Sweepers in 60+ cities, the Veil, rot, and three TV channels per country ([EVENT-048](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)). It worked *once*, under conditions that no longer exist. Not a mystery â€” a postmortem.
6. **Why Arthur's shadow lags ~3 seconds.** It is a tether; the lag is translation delay between substrates ([29_PROTAGONIST_ANOMALY.md](29_PROTAGONIST_ANOMALY.md)). Author-level CANON. (What stands at the other end is L5-2 â€” *that* is the mystery. The mechanism is explained; the entity is not. The distinction is the whole game.)
7. **Why the Veil can't be trained away.** It's an involuntary cognitive immune response; removing it requires birth or a Seep event ([02_WORLD_RULES.md](02_WORLD_RULES.md)). Not a mystery â€” neurology.
8. **Why Arthur was hired at NQA.** His file was flagged *"Loud, unregistered, anomaly-adjacent"* and approved anyway ([EVENT-087](25_TIMEmessaging app.md)). The *approval* is PROVISIONAL â€” someone wanted him inside, identity unknown â€” which makes it a **plot thread**, not a mystery: threads get pulled, mysteries get pondered. (If the approver's identity is never meant to pay off, it will be reclassified as a bug in audit.)

## 34.3 The five most important alliance structures

### 1. The Neutral Infrastructure Pact (SUP-002 + SUP-010 + INTL-007)
**Who:** The Cartographers (maps), the Ferrymen (routes), the Memorandum Group (intel-sharing).
**What each wants:** Cartographers want their neutrality *protected* (waystation custom + Accords clause); Ferrymen want routes undisturbed and cargo unasked-about; the Memorandum Group wants *visibility* â€” the one place spies can see the board.
**Why it matters:** This is the hidden world's *circulatory system*. Maps + movement + information, run by three actors who trust each other because they've been betrayed by everyone else. If it breaks, the hidden world goes blind and immobile simultaneously. The Bell knows this â€” Cartographers are murdered, Ferrymen crews killed, precisely to *degrade* it.
**Ravenhurst angle:** The Vladivostokâ€“Ravenhurst Pacific relay is the Pact's newest artery â€” and its most exposed, ending at Blackwater Syndicate-controlled berths (RC-001..010 range).

### 2. The Care Axis (SUP-003 + SUP-001 + IND-002 + IND-005)
**Who:** The Quiet Garden (Erosion care), the Drowned Choir (hospices), the Rememberers (Loud trauma), the Pro Bono Lanterns (street medicine).
**What each wants:** The Garden wants *referral flow* (burned-out Attuned finding the gardens); the Choir wants *legitimacy* (its hospices as the public face of a controversial faith); the Rememberers want *clinical protocols* (Dr. Eze's appendix, Garden co-developed); the Lanterns want *training and backup* (Garden clinicians, Ledger field-medicine).
**Why it matters:** The only alliance built on *healing rather than leverage*. It holds the hidden world's medical commons â€” and therefore holds *everyone's* people: every faction's wounded end up in Garden beds, Choir hospices, or Lantern clinics. Attack the Axis and you make enemies of every faction's medics simultaneously. Even the Bell treads carefully here â€” the essay's note that the two bombed gardens were "Ninth Bell bombings the Peal quietly regretted" is the *Care Axis's claim* (in-world advocacy, not established fact: the Bell's own record neither confirms nor denies, and the Quiet Garden's registry still lists both bombings as Bell-attributed). The Bell's guilt stays open; the Axis's forgiveness is stated as the Axis's.
**Ravenhurst angle:** The Choir's Ravenhurst hospice + the Akari cell's street work + the Night Clerks' storm logs = the Care Axis's primary-region footprint. Arthur's NQA branch sits adjacent â€” claims data *is* triage data.

### 3. The Security Contracting Chain (SUP-004 + INTL-004 + INTL-006)
**Who:** The Red Ledger (operators), the Seismograph Authority (detection + retainers), Joint Containment Command (tasking).
**What each wants:** The Ledger wants *contracts and the pension plan* (post-Compact contingency); the Authority wants *deniable surge capacity* for T4+ events; the Command wants *competence without headcount*.
**Why it matters:** This is how the Compact *fights* â€” detection (Authority) â†’ decision (Command) â†’ deniable professionals (Ledger). The chain's integrity is the masquerade's military backbone. Its weak point is the Code: the Ledger refuses Choir work, Drowndust, infohazards, and children â€” which means the Command's *dirtiest* requirements flow elsewhere (to the Hollow Men fences' "last dive" market â€” the chain's shadow twin).
**Ravenhurst angle:** Storm-season T4+ events are the chain's primary-region test. The Ledger's Sahel/Carpathian training grounds are far; its *Ravenhurst* response times are the metric everyone watches.

### 4. The Provenance Economy (SUP-009 + SUP-002 + SUP-008 + CORP-008)
**Who:** The Pale Court (collectors), the Cartographers (maps/surveys), the Archivists (authentication), Argent Vault (escrow).
**What each wants:** The Court wants *authenticated, exclusive pieces* (status + security); the Cartographers want *buyers* for first-survey rights; the Archivists want *fees and control* (provenance as leverage); Argent Vault wants *the float* (escrow on every deal).
**Why it matters:** The hidden world's *legitimate* anomaly market â€” the reason Gray Markets stay gray rather than black. It launders the supernatural into *collectibles*, which keeps T0â€“T3 objects out of the wrong hands by putting them in *rich* hands. The Compact tolerates it because the alternative (every auction in the Sahel) is worse. Its fragility: the Court's four unregistered T4+ pieces â€” if the Tribunal ever *enforces*, the economy's trust layer cracks.
**Luzon angle:** Pampang's moon-market is the Provenance Economy's Luzon retail end â€” small lots, sealed Rule descriptions (the Gavel's method, LOC-012), and Court "friends of the family" in Liwanag Heights bidding by phone.

### 5. The Street Symbiosis (IND-004 + SUP-010 + CRIM-001 + IND-005)
**Who:** The Night Clerks (eyes), the Ferrymen (movement), the Koi Network (gentle hands), the Pro Bono Lanterns (cover).
**What each wants:** The Clerks want *protection and early warning* (the quiet rota); the Ferrymen want *street-level eyes* in every port; the Koi want *trusted last-mile handlers* for living cargo; the Lanterns want *logistics they don't have to ask about* (the awkward truce â€” see IND-005).
**Why it matters:** The working-class alliance â€” no diplomats, no treaties, just *crews*. It moves people (defectors, witnesses, Loud children), information (malam files), and living anomalies, under the cover of *ordinary night work*. Every faction's leadership underestimates it; every faction's field operators *depend* on it. The Lagos compiler (IND-004) is its brain; the Ferrymen's Last Route (SUP-010) is its contingency; the Koi's unpublished precept (CRIM-001) is its conscience.
**Ravenhurst angle:** This is *Arthur's* alliance â€” the one a night-shift records clerk can actually touch. The Akari cell is being born *inside* it (NQA clerks + Night Clerk hub + Lantern street workers). Whatever Arthur becomes, it starts here.

## 34.4 The five most volatile rivalries

### 1. The Ninth Bell vs. the Meridian Compact (SUP-007 vs INTL-001/INTL-006)
**The shape:** Existential, asymmetric, *slow*. The Bell plans the Peal (nine simultaneous thinnings; eight sites known, the ninth hunted); the Compact hunts Rectors it can't find with deterrence that doesn't deter.
**Flashpoint:** The ninth site. The Compact's largest quiet manhunt; the Bell's Tenth Bell heresy pushing for *continuous public* thinning. If the heresy wins internally, the Peal's timetable collapses from "years" to "now."
**What each wants from the other:** The Bell wants the Compact *distracted* (every hunted Rector is a decoy for a working cell); the Compact wants *one live Rector* (interrogation, not martyrdom â€” hence the Ledger's "preferably talkative" contract).
**RC interlock:** International generators (RC-001..010) â€” drifting EEZ still-zones (RC-001 The Spratly Drift), the strait blink (RC-003), chokepoint freight (RC-004): sovereignty disputes the Bell can *tune* â€” thinnings disguised as incidents.

### 2. The Drowned Choir vs. the Ninth Bell (SUP-001 vs SUP-007)
**The shape:** Theological civil war. Same root (1953/1988 schism), opposite eschatons: the Choir's *salvation-approaching* vs. the Bell's *door-forced-open*. They recruit from the same grieving, which makes every funeral a contested space.
**Flashpoint:** The Cantorate succession (Sarr's election due ~3 years). An Immersionist Voice Prime means open defiance of the Compact *and* escalation against the Bell; a Reformist means mainstreaming â€” which the Bell reads as *surrender* and punishes.
**What each wants from the other:** The Choir wants the Bell *excommunicated from the human story* (not debated â€” *unpersoned*); the Bell wants the Choir's *congregation* (400,000 adherents who already believe the Tide is sacred â€” one theological nudge from Bell doctrine).
**Luzon angle:** The Daungan hospice vs. the Bell's Luzon cells â€” recruitment ground zero in the Philippines. The Ravenhurst hospice vs. the Bell's Ravenhurst cells is the same contest, newly opened.

### 3. The Red Ledger vs. the Hollow Men fences (SUP-004 vs SUP-006 trafficking tier)
**The shape:** Professional extermination vs. profitable nihilism. The Ledger's kill-on-sight policy for Erosion traffickers; the fences' receipts on every "last dive" ever brokered â€” including the ones *governments* bought.
**Flashpoint:** The dead-man's archive (SUP-006 secret). If a fence dies badly â€” Ledger operation, Bell hit, overdose â€” the receipts publish. Three governments' deniable T4â€“T5 purchases become *public*. The Ledger knows; that's why its operators have standing orders to take fences *alive* when possible (dead men's switches don't negotiate).
**What each wants from the other:** The Ledger wants the fences *ended* (the Code); the fences want the Ledger *deterred* (the archive). Mutually assured exposure.
**RC interlock:** Intelligence generators (RC-031..040) â€” the KNF mole (RC-032), the Vladivostok asset (RC-033), the Sunda Run (RC-038): the primary region's ports as everyone's listening posts.

### 4. The Naga Hitam succession (CRIM-002 internal; BPF adjacent)
**The shape:** A dying queen, three armed heirs, and the Priok veto. Dewi Mahmud's illness accelerates the examination; the "quiet work" kepala (Attuned wing), the political kepala (old money), and the nephew (continuity) maneuver â€” while BPF's new anti-syndicate chief stops believing in vetoes.
**Flashpoint:** The Drowndust cache (CRIM-002 secret). If the succession turns violent, the cache becomes *currency* â€” and BPF learning about it means the veto dies *before* the succession resolves, which means open war on the docks.
**What each wants from the others:** The nephew wants *legitimacy* (Dewi's keiretsu dream); the quiet-work kepala wants *power commensurate with the seeping future*; the political kepala wants *stability for the envelope calendar*; BPF wants the veto *renegotiated on its terms*.
**Regional note:** Jakarta-side, but its shockwaves reach Ravenhurst â€” the Ferrymen's harbor understandings are *portable*, and a Priok war reroutes Pacific traffic through Ravenhurst's berths.

### 5. The Ash Exchange vs. everyone (CRIM-003; the Bone Ledger)
**The shape:** The market-maker everyone hates and uses. The Exchange triple-deals the apocalypse (Drowndust to the Bell, intelligence to the Compact, auctions to everyone) while the Smelters push to *manufacture* Drownings at scale.
**Flashpoint:** The succession â€” Signora Cenere is dying with no heir; the Undertakers maneuver; the Smelters' industrial-Drowning faction is one board vote from trying. Industrial Drowning draws the Compact's *full* weight â€” which is exactly what the Bell wants (chaos as cover for the Peal).
**What each wants from the other:** The Exchange wants *the Bone Ledger to stay unread* (leverage); the Compact wants it *read* (the complete Drowning census); the Bell wants the Smelters to *win* (supply); the Choir wants the whole enterprise *excommunicated*.
**RC interlock:** Anomaly-related generators (RC-041..050) â€” the Wreck Choir's inherited sinking-memories (RC-041), the Market of Yesterday (RC-047), the Trench Front (RC-050): anomaly commerce, haunting demand, and the escalation ladder's far end.

## 34.5 Regional overlay: how the matrix plays in Ravenhurst City

> CANON (regional lens): The global matrix above *tilts* in the primary region. Ravenhurst-specific dynamics:

- **The SMD's balancing act** (GOV-006, the Special Measures Division â€” profiled in `06_GOVERNMENTS.md`): better funded than the KNF, more formal than the BPF â€” it *wardens* Ravenhurst with paperwork as its weapon. The Ravenhurst understanding with the Blackwater Syndicate (CRIM-007), quiet observation of the Akari cell (SUP-005), live-and-let-live toward the Ravenhurst Night Clerk hub (IND-004), *for now*. The formality is the tell: SMD files everything, including the things it pretends not to see.
- **The KNF's balancing act** (GOV-014, the Kawanihan ng Fenomena â€” profiled in `06_GOVERNMENTS.md`): too small to dominate, too sovereign to obey â€” it *referees* Liwanag's storm-season waterfront with cross-strait paranoia. Its stance toward the Liwanag Night Clerk hub and the Combine's Daungan waterfront is the secondary region's relationship to watch.
- **The Akari formation** is the matrix's *newest edge*: Lantern Bearers coalescing inside the Street Symbiosis (Â§34.3.5), around NQA's Ravenhurst night shift. No faction has a policy for it yet â€” which means every faction is *improvising*, which is when mistakes happen.
- **The Ravenhurst waterline:** The Blackwater Syndicate (CRIM-007) is the overlay's *newest named power* â€” holding the container berths through licensed front firms, terminating the Ferrymen's Vladivostokâ€“Ravenhurst relay, and playing the SMD's Ravenhurst understanding like an instrument. Its front-vs.-family tension (Kuroda vs. the young presidents) is Ravenhurst's most combustible internal conflict; the Alon Combine's Ravenhurst chapter works the ferry routes under managed friction.
- **The Daungan waterline:** The Alon Combine (CRIM-006) remains Liwanag's dockside power â€” holding the waterfront, running the relay's Liwanag end, and playing the KNF's Daungan understanding like an instrument. Its pier-vs.-deep succession fight (Salonga vs. Lena) is Liwanag's most combustible internal conflict.
- **Pampang's moon-market** is where the Provenance Economy (Â§34.3.4) meets the Salt Road's ethos â€” small, personal, *polite*. The Pale Court's Liwanag Heights buyers, Koi brokers, and Ferrymen couriers share tables; the Night Clerks log it all.
- **Storm season** is the matrix's *stress test*: pressure spikes degrade every alliance's bandwidth simultaneously. The Care Axis (Â§34.3.2) surges; the Security Contracting Chain (Â§34.3.3) strains; the Bell *likes* storms (cover for thinnings).
- **Arthur's position:** At the intersection of the Street Symbiosis and the Care Axis â€” a Loud clerk with perfect recall, no power, thin-file precarity, and *access to the claims*. Every alliance in Â§34.3 has a reason to recruit him; every rivalry in Â§34.4 has a reason to *remove* him. His survival strategy (per `01_CORE_PREMISE.md`): observation, preparation, rule-exploitation â€” applied to *relationships*, not just anomalies.

# 36 â€” TERMINOLOGY

Every coined term in the bible, with its canon status. In-world characters use these words; the glossary notes where the in-world meaning differs from the objective truth.

| Term | Definition | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **The Undertow** | The deeper substrate beneath the Membrane; raw unstructured information where causality/time/identity do not hold | CANON (objective truth; unknown to characters as such) |
| **The Membrane** | The thin layer of reality humans inhabit, where causality holds | CANON (objective truth) |
| **Seep** | Any place/object/organism/event/information where Undertow pressure has intruded and set | CANON |
| **Anomaly** | Meridian Compact's official term for a Seep | CANON |
| **Rule** | The fixed, alien, discoverable logic a Seep follows | CANON |

| **Loud** | A person the Veil barely touches; remembers Seep events | CANON |

| **Hollow Pattern** | The cortical folding variant enabling channeling | CANON |
| **First Tide / Awakening** | The trigger event that activates a carrier | CANON |
| **Resonance** | An Attuned's specific ability; unique neural pattern | CANON |
| **Discipline** | The five channel-shapes: Lantern, Tide, Bone, Choir, Hollow | CANON |
| **Erosion** | Irreversible wearing of the self by channeling | CANON |
